verdict.rationale: Ledgy supports service-account based OAuth2 credentials that are scoped per integration, short-lived, with immediate revocation and safe rotation workflows — a reasonable least-privilege mechanism an agent integration could use. However, there is no explicit fine-grained permission/role model (e.g., read-only vs write, per-resource scopes) or documentation framed around AI-agent use specifically. missing for 10: granular permission/scope controls beyond 'per integration', explicit agent-oriented credential issuance guidance.
